records.title: Modernization of Government of India Presses.
details: a to c): The modernization of Minto Road Press has already been initiated and at advance stage of completion and the finalization of modalities for modernization of remaining presses is at consideration stage.

records.title: Reduction in Frequency of Flight Service.
details: b to d: The Nashik Airport, owned and operated by HAL, was identified for development and operationalisation during the first round of bidding under UDAN. Accordingly, an amount of Rs. 11.19 Crore was incurred on development of the airport.

records.title: Establishment of Dry Port in Nashik
details: a to b: Yes. The Multi Modal Logistics Park (MMLP) proposal is with Ministry of Road, Transport & Highways (MoRTH) for approval of project cost.

records.title: Expressway from Nashik to Wadhwan Port
details: Part (a); However, alignment for connecting Wadhwan port to Delhi Mumbai Expressway has been approved.
